goals.text: Every namespace kmaudit stores can be listed and briefed.

outcomes.change: Read-only store URIs are built from Path.as_uri, so nested namespaces open
outcomes.checked_by: tests that run `kmaudit namespaces --json` and `kmaudit briefing` in a git repository with a store for `handbook/guides` holding a section, which must list its counts; and that the legacy store copy works from a repository path holding `%` and `#`

problems.text: kmaudit namespaces and kmaudit briefing fail with "unable to open database file" whenever a repository has a nested namespace, because the read-only SQLite URI decodes the %2F in its file name.
